messages:
adrian.k: Hey team — I've put together a first-pass PRD for scoped API keys + org/projects integration. Link: https://redwood.intern/docs/prd/scoped-keys-v1 (draft). Need design + launch tradeoffs by EOD Thursday.

sara.pm: skimmed the doc — high level looks good. can we add explicit acceptance criteria for "no data leakage" between projects? customers will ask.

adrian.k: yes — added 'isolation test matrix' to ACs. core ACs I'm targeting: 1) tokens only grant listed scopes, 2) project isolation for read/write, 3) migration doesn't break existing keys.

ben.eng: quick gap: how do we represent scopes in tokens? string scopes in JWT, or opaque token with introspection? both have tradeoffs.

lee.prodsec: prefer opaque with introspection for private deployments (no KMS in control plane). JWT is fine for hosted but leakier surface. mention both in design and fallback.

mike.sre: from infra side we also care about revocation latency and cache invalidation. AC should include "revoke within 30s for hosted" and best-effort for private.

adrian.k: added revocation SLA: hosted: 30s target, dedicated: 60s, private: depends on customer config — doc will require a revocation hook.

ben.eng: implementation note — we can implement scoped tokens as signed JWTs with a short ttl for hosted (e.g. 5m) + opaque long-lived API keys for users. Also introduce "scoped API key" resource linked to (org, project, role).

adrian.k: draft API examples in doc. snippet: 
``` 
POST /v1/keys
{
  "name": "ci-deploy-key",
  "scopes": ["chat:invoke","models:read"],
  "project_id": "proj_123"
}

Response:
{ "key": "sk_live_xxx...", "type": "scoped" }
```

lee.prodsec: add required fields: created_by, last_used, rotations, and policy_id for org-wide policies. Also add audit log requirement.

adrian.k: done. Also added acceptance criteria: audit events for "key created/used/revoked/rotated" ingested into console within 60s.

sara.pm: prioritization question — customers ask for per-project keys vs. org-level patterns. propose MVP support project-scoped keys + org policies; org-level keys as follow-on. Thoughts?

ben.eng: agree. project-scoped covers 90% of immediate customer requests. org-level keys need more RBAC surfaces in the console.

lee.prodsec: also consider roles mapping: map internal roles => permissions. suggest start with minimal role set: reader, writer, admin, infra. document edge-case where a role is later expanded — we must ensure existing keys don't silently gain perms. AC: retroactive permission expansion must not affect previously issued keys unless explicitly rotated.

mike.sre: ops checklist: telemetry, alerting, and chaos tests. add metric: fraction of requests authenticated by scoped key, revocation errors, and token-introspection latency.

adrian.k: adding rollout plan:
- Phase 0 (internal beta): implement opaque project-scoped keys + console UI behind feature flag.
- Phase 1 (public beta): hosted + dedicated customers opt-in, SDK support + CLI commands.
- Phase 2 (GA): public release, migration tooling, org policies, default deny for new orgs.

ben.eng: migration path: existing api keys -> map to org default project if they had single project usage; otherwise create an "org-default" scoped key and email owners. include a one-week automatic mapping before forced rotation.

lee.prodsec: legal/compliance: include customer-managed key options for Private and Dedicated for token signing, and ensure HSM/KMS note in doc.

adrian.k: added compliance note. also included acceptance criteria table and edge cases section:
- edge 1: key created for deleted project -> must return 403 and mark key orphaned
- edge 2: role expanded after key issuance -> do not auto-grant; require explicit rotation
- edge 3: cross-org token replay -> ensure project scoping and audience checks in runtime

sara.pm: can you add concrete SDK + CLI commands to the doc? we'll need small examples for Go, Python, and our CLI. Also add manual test plan for QA.

adrian.k: will add those tonight. sample CLI: `rw keys create --project proj_123 --scopes chat:invoke,models:embed --name ci-key`

mike.sre: one more: include a fallback routing policy when scoped model variants are not available (e.g., fallback to smaller model with explicit cost warning). this ties into runtime routing and is critical for reliability.

adrian.k: noted — added fallback policy section and acceptance criteria for graceful degradation.

lee.prodsec: propose we require a security review and a perf regression test before GA — add to launch checklist.

adrian.k: added security review + perf gating. action items: @ben.eng to draft token format options and perf estimate, @mike.sre to list monitoring hooks and SLOs, @sara.pm to validate ACs with customers (esp. enterprise accounts), @lee.prodsec to own security review. I'll update PRD and ping again.

auth-bot: Deployment reminder: security/ruleset v2 scheduled for 1831600000 — ensure PRD flags are merged before that to avoid conflicts.

ben.eng: starting token format doc now — ETA Wednesday.

mike.sre: I'll stub monitoring dashboards and post links.

sara.pm: prepping customer AC validation calls — adding to calendar.

adrian.k: thanks all — would love quick thumbs when you update your sections. :thumbsup:
